contexts.text: There were some who had general affection... They induced lassitude of the lower mind, with as it were lassitude of the body... because there is but little vital in such a general affection... Life itself consists in the intelligence and wisdom of truth, and if this is absent... there is lassitude.
The Angels are in continual potency; and after the act there is never lassitude... but alacrity of life...
